chunks: Since the Quraish have been united,

key_terms.إِيلاَف: Unity, familiarity, or being accustomed to something; here referring to the cohesion and security of the Quraish.
key_terms.قُرَيْش: The Quraish, the prominent tribe of Mecca to which the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) belonged.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Li-ilaafi Quraysh in Surah Quraysh?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the divine favor (ni'mah) bestowed upon the Quraish, specifically their security during the seasonal trade caravans, which served as a precursor to the broader blessings of prophethood. Scholars emphasize that this stability was not merely political but a spiritual preparation for the revelation of the Quran, linking their material comfort to their eventual responsibility in conveying the message.
